On its seat lay a second bottle, sealed with wax and filled with sand.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市还没有醒。路灯照着湿漉漉的人行道，清洁车缓缓驶过，留下淡淡的水痕。便利店的灯亮着，店员给赶早班的人热一杯豆浆。远处，一扇厨房窗户透出暖光。天边渐渐泛白，第一班公交车停在站台前，等候的人收起手机，走进车里。","w03":"- Recursion means solving a problem by using a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Imagine opening a box and finding a smaller box inside, then another smaller one.\n- You need a stopping point: when you reach the last box, you stop opening boxes."}
